title: Izchil (konsekutiv) tarjimaga kirish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida eshitgan qisqa nutqingizni belgilar bilan yozib olasiz, ma’no bo‘laklariga bo‘lasiz, raqam va ismlarni aniq yetkazasiz hamda tarjimani birinchi shaxsda ishonchli yetkazib, xatoni qisqa tuzatasiz.

scenes.title: Izchil tarjimaga kirish
board: Yozuv belgilari · xotira · raqam va ismlar · yetkazish
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda yozma tarjima asoslarini o‘rgandik. Bugun matn qog‘ozda emas, ovozda. Izchil, ya’ni konsekutiv tarjimada notiq gapiradi, to‘xtaydi, siz esa xabarni ikkinchi tilda yetkazasiz. Dars oxirida siz qisqa yozuv belgilaridan foydalanasiz, eshitganingizni ma’no bo‘laklariga bo‘lasiz, raqam va ismlarni aniq olasiz hamda tarjimani ishonchli va xatolarni to‘g‘rilab yetkazasiz. Bu darsda siz o‘zbek va ingliz tilida ishlaysiz, lekin bizning matnlarimiz inglizcha va ko‘pincha o‘zbekchaga o‘giriladi. Esda tuting: tarjimon so‘zlarni emas, fikrni eslab qoladi.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we looked at translation on paper. Today the text has no paper at all. In consecutive interpreting, a speaker talks, pauses, and you render the message in the other language. You will learn to take notes, chunk what you hear, handle numbers and names, and deliver with confidence.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingizdan xursandman. Oldingi darsda qog‘ozdagi tarjimani ko‘rdik. Bugun qog‘ozning o‘zi yo‘q. Izchil tarjimada notiq gapiradi, to‘xtaydi, siz esa xabarni boshqa tilda yetkazasiz. Yozuvlar olishni, eshitganingizni bo‘laklashni, raqam va ismlarni aniq olishni va ishonchli yetkazishni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Yozuv belgilari
board: vertical layout: one idea per line

examples.t: Exports rose by ten per cent, so the government plans new investment.
examples.uz: Eksport o‘n foizga o‘sdi, shuning uchun hukumat yangi investitsiya rejalashtirmoqda.

examples.t: The project is not finished because the funding was delayed.
examples.uz: Loyiha tugallanmagan, chunki moliyalashtirish kechikdi.

scenes.say_native: Konsekutiv tarjimada so‘zlarni emas, fikrlarni yozasiz, buning uchun belgi va qisqartmalar kerak. Strelka „→“ sabab yoki oqibatni, „↑“ o‘sishni, „↓“ pasayishni, „=“ tenglik yoki „bu — ...“ ni, „≠“ farqni, „?“ savolni, „∴“ demak, degan xulosani bildiradi. Qisqartmalar: „govt“ — government, „w/“ — with, „b/c“ — because, „esp“ — especially. Tartib: ega chap tomonda, har bir yangi fikr yangi qatorda, biroz pastroqda va o‘ng tomonda. Bu „zina“ tartibi ma’no bog‘lanishini ko‘rsatadi. Belgilarni o‘zingiz uchun bir xil saqlang: har safar boshqa belgi ishlatsangiz, o‘z yozuvingizni o‘qiy olmaysiz.
scenes.say: In consecutive interpreting you do not write down words. You note ideas, using symbols and short forms. An arrow shows cause or consequence, an up arrow a rise, a down arrow a fall. Write the subject on the left, and put each new idea on a new line, slightly lower and to the right. Use the language you are most comfortable with, and keep the symbols consistent.
scenes.say_uz: Konsekutiv tarjimada so‘zlarni emas, fikrlarni yozasiz, belgi va qisqartmalar yordamida. Strelka sabab yoki oqibatni, yuqoriga strelka o‘sishni, pastga strelka pasayishni bildiradi. Egani chap tomonga, har bir yangi fikrni yangi qatorga, biroz pastroq va o‘ngroqqa yozing. Belgilarni izchil saqlang.

scenes.title: Xato: gapni so‘zma-so‘z yozish
board: ✗ Exports have risen by ten per cent this year…

examples.t: Notes should trigger memory, not replace it.
examples.uz: Yozuv xotirani uyg‘otishi kerak, uning o‘rnini bosmasligi kerak.

examples.t: If you cannot read your notes, they are too long.
examples.uz: Yozuvingizni o‘qiy olmasangiz, ular juda uzun.

scenes.say_native: Boshlovchilarning eng keng tarqalgan xatosi — to‘liq gaplarni yozish. Birinchi gapni tugatguningizcha notiq yana uchta gap aytib bo‘ladi va siz tinglash o‘rniga sahifaga qarab o‘tirasiz. Yozuv xotirani uyg‘otishi kerak, uning o‘rnini bosmasligi kerak. Faqat osongina eslay olmaydigan narsani yozing: raqamlar, ismlar, ro‘yxatlar va fikrlar orasidagi bog‘lanish. Masalan, „Exports have risen by ten per cent this year“ ni „exports ↑ 10%“ deb yozasiz, hammasi shu. Imkon qadar ko‘zingizni notiqdan uzmang. Yozuv ham tinglashga xalaqit bermasin: tinglash — birinchi, yozish — ikkinchi.
scenes.say: The most common beginner mistake is writing full sentences. By the time you finish the first sentence, the speaker has said three more, and you are looking at the page instead of listening. Notes should trigger your memory, not replace it. Write only what you cannot remember easily: numbers, names, lists and links between ideas. Keep your eyes on the speaker whenever you can.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlovchilarning eng keng tarqalgan xatosi — to‘liq gaplarni yozish. Siz birinchi gapni tugatguncha notiq yana uchta gap aytadi. Yozuv xotirani uyg‘otishi kerak. Faqat raqamlar, ismlar, ro‘yxatlar va fikrlar bog‘lanishini yozing. Imkon qadar ko‘zingizni notiqdan uzmang.

scenes.title: Mashq: qisqa yozuv tuzing
board: Passage: Sales fell by five per cent because of the delay, so the company will hire new staff next month.
scenes.say_native: Tinglang va so‘z emas, belgi bilan yozing. Matn: savdo kechikish sababli besh foizga tushdi, shuning uchun kompaniya kelasi oy yangi xodimlar yollaydi. Endi yozuvingizga qarab xabarni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan ayting. Yozuv uchun uchdan beshtagacha belgi yetarli: pasayish, sabab, oqibat. Javobingizni keyingi sahnada tekshirasiz.
scenes.say: Listen and take notes with symbols, not words. Sales fell by five per cent because of the delay, so the company will hire new staff next month. Now say the message in your own words, using your notes.
scenes.say_uz: Belgilar bilan yozib oling. Savdo kechikish sababli besh foizga tushdi, shuning uchun kompaniya kelasi oy yangi xodimlar yollaydi. Endi yozuvingizga qarab xabarni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: yozuv
board: Rendering: Sales dropped five per cent because of the delay, so the company will hire staff next month.

examples.t: Sales dropped by five per cent because of the delay.
examples.uz: Savdo kechikish sababli besh foizga tushdi.

scenes.say_native: Mumkin yozuv: „sales ↓ 5% ← delay“, keyingi qatorda „∴ hire staff, next month“. Shundan siz aytasiz: savdo kechikish sababli besh foizga tushdi, shuning uchun kompaniya kelasi oy yangi xodim yollaydi. Beshta belgi yetdi. Sizning yozuvingiz boshqacha ko‘rinishi mumkin, muhimi, uni o‘zingiz tez o‘qiy olishingiz. Ko‘ryapsizmi, „because“ ni strelka bilan, „therefore“ ni uch nuqta belgisi bilan almashtirdik va fikrlar orasidagi bog‘lanish saqlandi. Yozuvning vazifasi — mantiqiy chizmani saqlash, so‘zlarni emas.
scenes.say: Possible notes: sales, a down arrow, five per cent, a left arrow for because, delay. On the next line: therefore, hire staff, next month. From these notes you can say: sales dropped by five per cent because of the delay, so the company will hire new staff next month. Five symbols were enough. Your notes may look different, as long as you can read them.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin yozuv: savdo, pastga strelka, besh foiz, sabab strelkasi, kechikish. Keyingi qatorda demak, xodim yollash, kelasi oy. Shundan xabarni to‘liq aytasiz. Beshta belgi yetdi. Yozuvingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, faqat o‘zingiz o‘qiy olsangiz bas.

scenes.title: Xotira va bo‘laklash
board: Chunk: who · did what · why · so what

examples.t: The minister announced a new fund, which will support small businesses in rural areas.
examples.uz: Vazir yangi jamg‘arma e’lon qildi, u qishloq joylardagi kichik biznesni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.

examples.t: Three factors explain the delay: weather, staffing and supply.
examples.uz: Kechikishni uchta omil tushuntiradi: ob-havo, xodimlar yetishmasligi va yetkazib berish.

scenes.say_native: Xotira tuzilmani tinglaganda yaxshilanadi. Eshitganingizni ma’no bo‘laklariga bo‘ling: kim nima qildi, nega va qanday natija bilan. Bo‘laklarni mantiqiy zanjirga bog‘lang, sahnani ko‘z oldingizga keltiring va tinglab turib ichingizda o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qayta ayting. Uchta omil aytilsa, barmog‘ingizda sanang. O‘rganish bosqichida o‘ttiz soniyadan oltmish soniyagacha bo‘lgan parchalardan boshlang, keyin asta-sekin uzaytiring. „The minister announced a new fund, which will support small businesses in rural areas“ — bu yerda bo‘laklar: vazir, yangi jamg‘arma, kichik biznes, qishloq. Shu to‘rt tayanch nuqta butun gapni tiklaydi.
scenes.say: Memory improves when you listen for structure. Break what you hear into chunks of meaning: who did what, why, and with what result. Link the chunks into a logical chain, picture the scene, and silently paraphrase as you listen. When there are three factors, count them on your fingers. In training, start with segments of thirty to sixty seconds, then increase gradually.
scenes.say_uz: Xotira tuzilmani tinglaganda yaxshilanadi. Eshitganingizni ma’no bo‘laklariga bo‘ling: kim nima qildi, nega va qanday natija bilan. Bo‘laklarni zanjirga bog‘lang, sahnani tasavvur qiling va ichingizda qayta ayting. O‘rganish bosqichida o‘ttiz soniyadan oltmish soniyagacha bo‘lgan parchalardan boshlang.

scenes.title: Xato: tafsilotga botib qolish
board: ✗ remembering every adjective and losing the main point

examples.t: The main point is that costs will rise next year.
examples.uz: Asosiy fikr shuki, kelasi yil xarajatlar oshadi.

examples.t: An interpreter adds nothing and omits nothing important.
examples.uz: Tarjimon hech narsa qo‘shmaydi va muhim narsani tushirib qoldirmaydi.

scenes.say_native: Boshlovchilar ko‘pincha tafsilotlarni yodlab, asosiy fikrni yo‘qotadi. Doim avval asosiy g‘oyani, keyin uning dalillarini toping. Yana ikkita tuzoq bor. O‘z fikringizni yoki izohingizni qo‘shmang: sizning vazifangiz — notiq xabarini yetkazish, uni yaxshilash emas. Va tushunish qiyin bo‘lgani uchun muhim fikrni tushirib qoldirmang. Nima muhimligini hal qiling va shuni saqlang. O‘zbek tilida odamlar ko‘pincha „ya’ni“ deb izoh qo‘shadi, tarjimon esa notiq aytmagan izohni qo‘shishga haqli emas. Agar biror joyni tushunmasangiz, taxmin qilib to‘ldirmang, notiqdan so‘rang.
scenes.say: Beginners often memorise the details and lose the main point. Always find the main idea first, then the support. Two further traps. Do not add your own opinion or explanation, because your job is to convey the speaker's message, not to improve it. And do not leave out an important point just because it was difficult to catch. Decide what is essential, and keep that.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlovchilar tafsilotlarni yodlab, asosiy fikrni yo‘qotadi. Avval asosiy g‘oyani, keyin dalilni toping. O‘z fikringizni qo‘shmang va muhim narsani tushirib qoldirmang. Nimani tushunmasangiz, taxmin qilib to‘ldirmang, notiqdan so‘rang.

scenes.title: Mashq: asosiy fikr va tayanchlar
board: Passage: The council will close the old bridge next week for repairs. Drivers should use the northern route, which adds about ten minutes. Work should finish in March.
scenes.say_native: Tinglang. Kengash kelasi hafta ta’mirlash uchun eski ko‘prikni yopadi. Haydovchilar shimoliy yo‘ldan foydalanishi kerak, bu taxminan o‘n daqiqa qo‘shadi. Ish martda tugashi kerak. Asosiy fikrni ayting, keyin uchta tayanch nuqtani sanang. Notiq nimani, qachon va nima uchun qilmoqchi? Javobingiz keyingi sahnada tekshiriladi.
scenes.say: Listen. The council will close the old bridge next week for repairs. Drivers should use the northern route, which adds about ten minutes. Work should finish in March. State the main idea, then give three supporting points.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang. Kengash kelasi hafta ta’mirlash uchun eski ko‘prikni yopadi. Haydovchilar shimoliy yo‘ldan foydalanishi kerak, bu taxminan o‘n daqiqa qo‘shadi. Ish martda tugashi kerak. Asosiy fikrni va uchta tayanch nuqtani ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: asosiy fikr
board: Main: the old bridge closes for repairs next week

examples.t: The old bridge will close next week for repairs.
examples.uz: Eski ko‘prik kelasi hafta ta’mir uchun yopiladi.

scenes.say_native: Asosiy fikr: eski ko‘prik kelasi hafta ta’mirlash uchun yopiladi. Uchta tayanch: haydovchilar shimoliy yo‘ldan foydalanishi kerak; aylanma yo‘l taxminan o‘n daqiqa qo‘shadi; ish martda tugashi kerak. Agar tayanchlarni shu tartibda aytgan bo‘lsangiz, notiq mantiqiga amal qilgansiz, tarjimonga aynan shu kerak. Ko‘ryapsizmi, to‘rtta bo‘lak kifoya: ko‘prik, hafta, yo‘l, vaqt. Shuning uchun matn qisqa bo‘lsa ham, bo‘laklash odatini shakllantiring.
scenes.say: The main idea: the old bridge will close next week for repairs. Three supports: drivers should use the northern route, the detour adds about ten minutes, and the work should finish in March. If you gave the supports in that order, you followed the speaker's logic, which is exactly what an interpreter must do.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy fikr: eski ko‘prik kelasi hafta ta’mirlash uchun yopiladi. Uchta tayanch: haydovchilar shimoliy yo‘ldan foydalanadi, aylanma yo‘l taxminan o‘n daqiqa qo‘shadi, ish martda tugaydi. Tayanchlarni shu tartibda aytgan bo‘lsangiz, notiq mantiqiga amal qilgansiz.

scenes.title: Raqamlar va ismlar

examples.t: The budget is three point two five million pounds.
examples.uz: Byudjet uch butun yigirma besh yuzdan bir million funt.

examples.t: The company was founded in 1998 and employs 4,500 people.
examples.uz: Kompaniya 1998 yilda tashkil etilgan va 4500 kishini ish bilan ta’minlaydi.

scenes.say_native: Raqam va ismlarni xotiradan tiklab bo‘lmaydi, shuning uchun darrov yozing. Raqam va belgilardan foydalaning: „£“, „$“, „€“, „%“, „kg“, „km“. Katta sonlarni uchtadan guruhlab yozing, shunda tez o‘qiysiz: „3,250,000“. Muhim farq: inglizcha „billion“ — ming million, ya’ni o‘zbekcha „milliard“. „Million“ esa o‘zbekchada ham million. Yoshni, yilni, foizni ham darhol yozing. Ismlar uchun bosh harflarni va bitta tayanch harfni yozing. Imkoniyat bo‘lsa, notiqdan „Could you spell that, please?“ deb so‘rashdan tortinmang, bu professional ish. Noto‘g‘ri aytilgan raqam ko‘pincha noto‘g‘ri aytilgan so‘zdan qimmatroqqa tushadi.
scenes.say: Numbers and names cannot be reconstructed from memory, so write them down immediately. Use digits and symbols. Group large numbers by thousands, three digits at a time, so you can read them quickly. English billion is one thousand million, which is the Uzbek milliard. For names, note the initials and a key letter, and do not hesitate to ask the speaker to spell or repeat them, when the setting allows.
scenes.say_uz: Raqam va ismlarni xotiradan tiklab bo‘lmaydi, darrov yozing. Raqam va belgilardan foydalaning. Katta sonlarni uchtadan guruhlang. Inglizcha billion ming million, o‘zbekcha milliard. Ismlar uchun bosh harflarni yozing va imkon bo‘lsa, notiqdan harflab aytishni so‘rang.

scenes.title: Xato: o‘nlik va yuzlik

examples.t: Fifteen has the stress on the second syllable, fifty on the first.
examples.uz: Fifteen urg‘usi ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda, fifty esa birinchisida.

examples.t: Three hundred and fifty thousand dollars.
examples.uz: Uch yuz ellik ming dollar.

scenes.say_native: Eshituvchilar „thirteen“ va „thirty“, „fifteen“ va „fifty“ ni adashtiradi. O‘n uch, o‘n besh kabi „-teen“ sonlarda urg‘u odatda ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: „thirTEEN“. O‘nliklarda urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: „THIRty“, oxirgi unli qisqaroq. Doim kontekst bilan tasdiqlang va raqamni yozing. Yana bir tuzoq — „billion“: uni „million“ deb emas, ming million deb tarjima qiling. Britaniya nutqida yuzdan keyin „and“ ko‘pincha qo‘shiladi: „three hundred and fifty“. Bu shunchaki o‘qilish, ma’noga ta’sir qilmaydi. Raqam eshitilgach yozib, qayta tekshiring.
scenes.say: Listeners confuse thirteen and thirty, or fifteen and fifty. In the teens, the stress is usually on the second syllable, thirTEEN. In the tens, it is on the first, THIRty, and the final vowel is shorter. Always confirm with context, and write the digits. Another trap is billion, which must be a thousand million, never just million. And in British speech, the word and often appears after hundred: three hundred and fifty.
scenes.say_uz: Eshituvchilar thirteen va thirty, fifteen va fifty ni adashtiradi. -teen sonlarda urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda, o‘nliklarda birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Doim kontekst bilan tasdiqlang va raqamni yozing. Billion ming million, million emas. Britaniya nutqida yuzdan keyin and qo‘shiladi.

scenes.title: Mashq: raqam va ismlar
board: Passage: Dr Amelia Whitfield will present on the fourteenth of June. The grant is two point four billion pounds, and fifty per cent goes to schools.
scenes.say_native: Tinglang va asosiy ma’lumotlarni yozing. Doktor Amelia Uitfild 14 iyun kuni ma’ruza qiladi. Grant 2,4 milliard funt, uning ellik foizi maktablarga ketadi. Ism, sana, summa va foizni ayting. Eslatma: „billion“ — milliard, „fifty“ da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Javobingiz keyingi sahnada tekshiriladi.
scenes.say: Listen and write the key data. Dr Amelia Whitfield will present on the fourteenth of June. The grant is two point four billion pounds, and fifty per cent goes to schools. Say the name, the date, the amount and the percentage.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang va asosiy ma’lumotlarni yozing. Doktor Amelia Uitfild 14 iyun kuni ma’ruza qiladi. Grant 2,4 milliard funt, ellik foizi maktablarga ketadi. Ism, sana, summa va foizni ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: raqam va ismlar

examples.t: The grant is £2.4 billion, and half goes to schools.
examples.uz: Grant 2,4 milliard funt, uning yarmi maktablarga ketadi.

scenes.say_native: Ism: doktor Amelia Uitfild. Sana: 14 iyun. Summa: 2,4 milliard funt, yozuvda „£2.4 bn“ yoki „£2.4B“. Foiz: ellik foiz maktablarga ketadi, ya’ni yarmi. O‘zbekchada „ikki butun to‘rt o‘ndan milliard“ deymiz, „million“ emas. Yaxshi yozuv shunday ko‘rinadi: „A. Whitfield“, „14 June“, „£2.4 bn“, „50% → schools“. Ko‘ryapsizmi, to‘rtta qisqa qator butun gapni tiklaydi. Eslatma: o‘zbek tilida kasr uchun „butun“ va „o‘ndan“ so‘zlari ishlatiladi, ingliz tilida esa „point“.
scenes.say: The name is Dr Amelia Whitfield. The date is the fourteenth of June. The amount is two point four billion pounds, written as pounds sign two point four B. And fifty per cent goes to schools, which means half. In Uzbek, say two point four milliard, not million. Good notes would show A dot Whitfield, one four June, pound two point four B, and fifty percent arrow schools.
scenes.say_uz: Ism: doktor Amelia Uitfild. Sana: 14 iyun. Summa: 2,4 milliard funt. Foiz: ellik foizi, ya’ni yarmi maktablarga ketadi. O‘zbekchada milliard deymiz, million emas. Yaxshi yozuvda bu to‘rtta qisqa qatorda ko‘rinadi.

scenes.title: Yetkazish va o‘zini tuzatish
board: steady pace · clear voice · eye contact
self-correction: "Correction: …" / "Apologies, the interpreter would like to correct…"

examples.t: We will deliver the first batch in March.
examples.uz: Birinchi partiyani martda yetkazib beramiz.

examples.t: Apologies, the interpreter would like to correct that figure: fifteen, not fifty.
examples.uz: Uzr, tarjimon bu raqamni tuzatmoqchi: o‘n besh, ellik emas.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi shaxsdan gapiring: notiq „We will deliver in March“ desa, siz „We will deliver in March“ deysiz, „he says they will deliver“ emas. O‘zbek tilida ham shunday: „Biz martda yetkazib beramiz“, „u aytyaptiki...“ emas. Sur’atni bir xil, ovozni xotirjam saqlang, tinglovchilarga qarang. Xatoni sezsangiz, qisqa tuzating va davom eting: „Apologies, the interpreter would like to correct that“. Eshitmagan bo‘lsangiz, taxmin qilmay, notiqdan takrorlashni so‘rang: „Could the speaker repeat the last figure, please?“ Bu zaiflik emas, professionallik. To‘xtab qolsangiz, vahima qilmang: nafas oling, yozuvingizga qarang va davom eting.
scenes.say: Deliver in the first person: if the speaker says we will deliver in March, you say we will deliver in March, not he says they will deliver. Keep a steady pace, look at your audience, and keep your voice calm. If you notice a mistake, correct it briefly and move on: apologies, the interpreter would like to correct that. If you did not catch something, ask the speaker to repeat it rather than guess.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi shaxsdan gapiring: notiq we will deliver in March desa, siz ham shunday deysiz. Sur’atni bir xil, ovozni xotirjam saqlang va tinglovchilarga qarang. Xatoni sezsangiz, qisqa tuzating va davom eting. Eshitmagan bo‘lsangiz, notiqdan takrorlashni so‘rang.

scenes.title: Xato: to‘xtab, uzoq uzr so‘rash
board: ✗ Oh no, sorry, I made a terrible mistake, I am so sorry…

examples.t: Correction: the delivery is in March, not May.
examples.uz: Tuzatish: yetkazib berish martda, mayda emas.

examples.t: Could the speaker repeat the last figure, please?
examples.uz: Notiq oxirgi raqamni takrorlay oladimi, iltimos?

scenes.say_native: Xato qilsangiz, uzoq uzr so‘rash xatoning o‘zidan ko‘ra ko‘proq diqqatni tortadi. „Correction“ deng, to‘g‘ri ma’lumotni ayting va davom eting: „Correction: the delivery is in March, not May“. Boshqa keng tarqalgan xato — uchinchi shaxsda yetkazish: „he says“, „she says“. Bunda tinglovchi ikki ovozni eshitadi va siz sekinlashasiz. Va nihoyat, „um“, „er“ kabi to‘ldiruvchi tovushlardan qoching, o‘rniga jimgina to‘xtab oling. Jimlik odatda tinglovchiga uzoq ko‘rinmaydi, to‘ldiruvchi tovushlar esa ishonchsizlik sezdiradi.
scenes.say: When you make a mistake, a long apology draws more attention to it than the mistake itself. Say correction, give the right information, and continue. Another common error is reporting in the third person, he says, she says, which makes the audience hear a double voice and slows you down. Finally, avoid filler sounds, like um and er, by pausing silently instead.
scenes.say_uz: Xato qilsangiz, uzoq uzr so‘rash xatoning o‘zidan ko‘ra ko‘proq diqqatni tortadi. Correction deng, to‘g‘ri ma’lumotni ayting va davom eting. Uchinchi shaxsda yetkazmang. Um, er kabi to‘ldiruvchi tovushlar o‘rniga jimgina to‘xtab oling.

scenes.title: Mashq: yetkazish
board: Passage: We will deliver the first batch in March, and the second in May. The total price is twenty thousand dollars.
scenes.say_native: Tinglang. Birinchi partiyani martda, ikkinchisini mayda yetkazib beramiz. Umumiy narx yigirma ming dollar. Avval xabarni birinchi shaxsda takrorlang. Keyin tasavvur qiling, siz adashib „aprel“ degansiz, va o‘zingizni qisqa tuzating. „Correction“ so‘zini ishlating. Javobingiz keyingi sahnada.
scenes.say: Listen. We will deliver the first batch in March, and the second in May. The total price is twenty thousand dollars. First, repeat the message in the first person. Then imagine you said April by mistake, and correct yourself briefly.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang. Birinchi partiyani martda, ikkinchisini mayda yetkazib beramiz. Umumiy narx yigirma ming dollar. Avval xabarni birinchi shaxsda takrorlang. Keyin adashib aprel degan bo‘lsangiz, o‘zingizni qisqa tuzating.

scenes.title: Javoblar: yetkazish
board: We will deliver the first batch in March and the second in May.

examples.t: Correction: the second batch is in May, not April.
examples.uz: Tuzatish: ikkinchi partiya aprelda emas, mayda.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi shaxsdagi variant: „We will deliver the first batch in March and the second in May. The total price is twenty thousand dollars.“ Tuzatish: „Correction, the second batch is in May, not April.“ U qisqa, xotirjam va faqat to‘g‘ri ma’lumotni beradi, shuning uchun tinglovchi xatoni deyarli sezmaydi. Uzr so‘rash uzoq bo‘lmagani ham yaxshi. Agar siz „he says“ deb boshlagan bo‘lsangiz, uni olib tashlab, to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri notiq nomidan gapiring. Mana, endi bugungi ko‘nikmalarni birlashtiramiz.
scenes.say: The first-person rendering is: we will deliver the first batch in March and the second in May. The total price is twenty thousand dollars. And the correction: correction, the second batch is in May, not April. It is short, calm and gives only the right information, so the audience hardly notices the slip.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi shaxsdagi variant: birinchi partiyani martda, ikkinchisini mayda yetkazib beramiz, umumiy narx yigirma ming dollar. Tuzatish: ikkinchi partiya aprelda emas, mayda. U qisqa, xotirjam va faqat to‘g‘ri ma’lumotni beradi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: biznes uchrashuv
board: Speaker: Last year our revenue reached 8.7 million.
Speaker: Because of the new market, we expect 12 million.
Interpreter: Could the speaker repeat the second figure?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbat — biznes uchrashuvi. Notiq: o‘tgan yili tushumimiz sakkiz butun yetti o‘ndan million dollarga yetdi, asosiy sabab shimolda yangi bozor ochilishi. Bu yil o‘n ikki million kutamiz. Tarjimon: ikkinchi raqamni takrorlay olasizmi? Notiq: albatta, o‘n ikki million, ya’ni o‘n ikki, ikki emas. Eshiting: „reached“, „expect“, raqamni aniqlash savoli va notiqning raqamni aniq takrorlashi, bu usul adashmaslik uchun.
scenes.say: Good afternoon. Last year our revenue reached eight point seven million dollars, and the main reason was the opening of the new market in the north. This year we expect twelve million. Could you repeat the second figure, please? Of course: twelve million, that is twelve, not two.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kun. O‘tgan yili tushumimiz sakkiz butun yetti o‘ndan million dollarga yetdi, asosiy sabab shimolda yangi bozor ochilishi. Bu yil o‘n ikki million kutamiz. Ikkinchi raqamni takrorlay olasizmi? Albatta: o‘n ikki million, ya’ni o‘n ikki, ikki emas.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. O‘tgan yilgi tushum qancha edi? Natijaning asosiy sababi nima? Notiq bu yil nimani kutmoqda? Raqamlarni to‘g‘ri ayting.
scenes.say: Three questions. What was last year's revenue? What was the main reason for the result? And what does the speaker expect this year?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. O‘tgan yilgi tushum qancha edi? Natijaning asosiy sababi nima? Notiq bu yil nimani kutmoqda?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
scenes.say_native: O‘tgan yilgi tushum — 8,7 million dollar. Asosiy sabab — shimolda yangi bozorning ochilishi. Bu yil notiq 12 million kutmoqda. Yaxshi yozuv: „rev 8.7M“, „b/c new market N“, „this yr 12M“. Bu uchta qator butun parchani tiklaydi. Siz ham aynan shunday qisqalikka intiling. Raqam so‘ralgan joyda javobni raqam bilan, birlikni esa so‘z bilan ayting: „million“ va „dollar“ ni tushirib qoldirmang.
scenes.say: Last year's revenue was eight point seven million dollars. The main reason was the opening of a new market in the north. This year the speaker expects twelve million. Good notes would be: revenue, eight point seven M, because new market, north, and this year, twelve M.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yilgi tushum 8,7 million dollar. Asosiy sabab — shimolda yangi bozorning ochilishi. Bu yil notiq 12 million kutmoqda. Yaxshi yozuv uchta qisqa qatordan iborat.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: tibbiy konferensiya
board: Speaker: Dr Nasrin Rahimova from Samarkand will chair the session.
Speaker: Registration closes on the ninth of May.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat — mintaqaviy sog‘liqni saqlash konferensiyasi. Notiq: mintaqaviy konferensiyaga xush kelibsiz. Samarqanddan doktor Nasrin Rahimova ochilish majlisiga raislik qiladi. Ro‘yxatdan o‘tish to‘qqizinchi mayda yopiladi, shuning uchun erta ro‘yxatdan o‘ting. Barcha ishtirokchilar suratli hujjat olib kelishi kerak, ikki kun ham tushlik beriladi. Diqqat: ism, shahar, sana va talab, to‘rtta tayanch nuqta.
scenes.say: Welcome to the regional health conference. Dr Nasrin Rahimova from Samarkand will chair the opening session. Registration closes on the ninth of May, so please register early. All participants should bring photo identification, and lunch will be provided on both days.
scenes.say_uz: Mintaqaviy sog‘liqni saqlash konferensiyasiga xush kelibsiz. Samarqanddan doktor Nasrin Rahimova ochilish majlisiga raislik qiladi. Ro‘yxatdan o‘tish to‘qqizinchi mayda yopiladi. Ishtirokchilar suratli hujjat olib kelishi kerak, ikki kun ham tushlik beriladi.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Ochilish majlisiga kim raislik qiladi va u qayerdan? Ro‘yxatdan o‘tish qachon yopiladi? Ishtirokchilar nimani olib kelishi kerak? Ism va sanani aniq ayting.
scenes.say: Questions. Who will chair the opening session, and where is she from? When does registration close? And what must participants bring?
scenes.say_uz: Savollar. Ochilish majlisiga kim raislik qiladi va u qayerdan? Ro‘yxatdan o‘tish qachon yopiladi? Ishtirokchilar nimani olib kelishi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
scenes.say_native: Raislik qiluvchi — Samarqanddan doktor Nasrin Rahimova. Ro‘yxatdan o‘tish 9 mayda yopiladi. Ishtirokchilar suratli hujjat olib kelishi kerak. Tushlik ikki kun ham beriladi, bu foydali tafsilot, yozuvingizda uni ham qoldirishingiz mumkin. Ismni imlo bilan to‘g‘ri aytish ham muhim: „Nasrin Rahimova“ ni o‘zgartirib yubormang, chunki ism egasi uchun bu hurmat belgisi. Agar ism qanday talaffuz qilinishini bilmasangiz, tadbirdan oldin tashkilotchilardan so‘rab oling.
scenes.say: Dr Nasrin Rahimova from Samarkand will chair the opening session. Registration closes on the ninth of May. Participants must bring photo identification. Lunch is also provided on both days, which is a useful detail to keep in your notes as well.
scenes.say_uz: Raislik qiluvchi Samarqanddan doktor Nasrin Rahimova. Ro‘yxatdan o‘tish to‘qqizinchi mayda yopiladi. Ishtirokchilar suratli hujjat olib kelishi kerak. Tushlik ikki kun ham beriladi. Ismni o‘zgartirib yubormang.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: parchani tarjima qiling
board: Passage 40 seconds: key points, numbers and a name
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Parchani tinglang. Port ma’muriyati direktori janob Deniel Xyuz o‘tgan yili yuk hajmi sakkiz foizga o‘sib, 4,5 million tonnaga yetganini, buning asosiy sababi yangi temir yo‘l aloqasi ekanini aytdi. Kelasi yil yana besh foiz o‘sish kutadi. Yozuv oling, keyin xabarni o‘zbek tilida yetkazing. Ism, raqam, sabab va prognozni unutmang. Keyingi sahnada namunani eshitasiz.
scenes.say: Final task. Listen to this passage. Mr Daniel Hughes, the director of the port authority, said that cargo volumes grew by eight per cent to four point five million tonnes last year, mainly because of the new rail link. He expects a further five per cent next year. Take notes, then render the message in Uzbek.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Parchani tinglang. Port ma’muriyati direktori janob Deniel Xyuz o‘tgan yili yuk hajmi sakkiz foizga o‘sib, 4,5 million tonnaga yetganini aytdi. Kelasi yil yana besh foiz kutadi. Yozuv oling va xabarni o‘zbekchada yetkazing.

scenes.title: Namuna yozuv va tarjima

examples.t: Cargo volumes grew by eight per cent to 4.5 million tonnes.
examples.uz: Yuk hajmi sakkiz foizga o‘sib, 4,5 million tonnaga yetdi.

scenes.say_native: Namuna yozuv: „D. Hughes, port dir.“, „cargo ↑ 8% → 4.5 M t ← rail link“, „next yr ↑ 5%“. O‘zbekchada: „Port direktori Deniel Xyuzning aytishicha, o‘tgan yili yuk hajmi sakkiz foizga o‘sib, 4,5 million tonnaga yetdi, asosiy sababi yangi temir yo‘l aloqasi. Kelasi yil yana besh foiz o‘sish kutilmoqda.“ Ko‘ryapsizmi: ism, raqamlar, sabab va prognoz saqlandi, ortiqcha so‘z yo‘q. Matn aniq va ravon bo‘lishi muhim: o‘zbek tilining tabiiy tuzilishida gapiring, inglizcha gap tuzilishini ko‘chirmang.
scenes.say: Model notes: D. Hughes, port director. Cargo, up eight per cent, to four point five million tonnes, because rail link. Next year, up five per cent. Your Uzbek rendering should carry the name, the two figures, the cause and the forecast.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna yozuv: port direktori Hughes, yuk hajmi sakkiz foizga o‘sib 4,5 million tonna, sabab yangi temir yo‘l, kelasi yil besh foiz. Ism, raqamlar, sabab va prognoz saqlandi. O‘zbek tilining tabiiy tuzilishida gapiring.

scenes.title: Bugungi dars xulosasi
board: numbers: digits at once · billion = milliard
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: fikrlarni belgilar bilan yozing, to‘liq gaplarni emas, tartib „zina“ shaklida. Ikkinchi: tuzilishni tinglang, ma’no bo‘yicha bo‘laklang: asosiy fikr va tayanchlar. Uchinchi: raqam va ismlarni darrov yozing, „billion“ ni „milliard“ deb tarjima qiling. To‘rtinchi: birinchi shaxsdan, xotirjam yetkazing, xatoni qisqa tuzating, eshitmagan bo‘lsangiz so‘rang. Shu to‘rt ko‘nikma konsekutiv tarjimaning asosi.
scenes.say: Here is the summary. Note ideas with symbols, not whole sentences. Listen for structure and chunk by meaning. Write numbers and names at once, and remember that billion means one thousand million. Deliver in the first person, and correct yourself briefly.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa. Fikrlarni belgilar bilan yozing. Tuzilishni tinglang va ma’no bo‘yicha bo‘laklang. Raqam va ismlarni darrov yozing, billion ming million ekanini unutmang. Birinchi shaxsdan yetkazing va xatoni qisqa tuzating.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Record your renderings and listen back
Success: all numbers and names correct, first person, no filler
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: beshta qisqa yozilgan parchani izchil tarjima qiling. Har birida yozuv oling, xabarni yetkazing, o‘zingizni yozib oling va qayta tinglang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: barcha raqam va ismlar to‘g‘ri, birinchi shaxsda yetkazilgan va to‘ldiruvchi tovushlarsiz bo‘lsa. Avval raqam va ismlarni tekshiring. Keyingi darsda diplomatik va yumshoq tilni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to interpret five short recorded passages. Take notes, render each one, record yourself and listen back. Check numbers and names first. Next lesson: diplomatic and softening language. Well done today.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: beshta qisqa yozilgan parchani izchil tarjima qiling, o‘zingizni yozib oling va qayta tinglang. Avval raqam va ismlarni tekshiring. Keyingi dars: diplomatik va yumshoq til. Bugun yaxshi ishladingiz.

homework_uz: Beshta qisqa yozilgan parchani izchil tarjima qiling: yozuv oling, xabarni yetkazing, o‘zingizni yozib oling va qayta tinglang. Raqam va ismlar to‘g‘ri, tarjima birinchi shaxsda va to‘ldiruvchi tovushlarsiz bo‘lsin. Keyingi dars: diplomatik va yumshoq til.

quiz.q: In consecutive interpreting you mainly note ___.
quiz.why_uz: Fikr, raqam va ismlar yoziladi, so‘zlar emas.

quiz.q: What does an arrow in notes often show?
How should you render "We will deliver in March"?
options: He says they will deliver in March.
The speaker told that he will deliver.
They will deliver in March, he said.

quiz.q: You notice a mistake in your rendering. The best reaction is:
If you missed a figure, you should ___.
options: ask the speaker to repeat it
dividing speech into units of meaning

quiz.q: Which should an interpreter NOT do?
Training segments at the start are usually ___.
